617:t_107:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「It's obvious, isn't it! To save the people being tormented by scum like you!」

617:t_107:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is merely your own self-satisfaction.」

617:t_107:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「So what if it is! Don't think words like that will stop me!」

617:t_107:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'll beat you and end this fighting! That's my way of fighting!!」

617:t_107:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then I will teach you this! That the end of battle is still out of sight!」

617:t_108:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_108:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「For the world, for the people... Even if I said words like that, they probably wouldn't reach you.」

617:t_108:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「So I'll say it boldly! I fight evil like you for my own sake!」

617:t_108:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「True... That one resonates more strongly with me now, too.」

617:t_108:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Man who embraces the sun! Offer your radiance to me!」

617:t_108:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「No way! The sun belongs to everyone!!」

617:t_109:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_109:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「No, to protect the peace of Earth!」

617:t_109:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't laugh! Both are important matters to me!」

617:t_109:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「If I beat you, Earth gets peace, and the odd-job requests will start pouring in again! In other words, two birds with one stone!」

617:t_109:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well, President! Your determination in this fight has come through!」

617:t_109:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will break that will! With this power!!」

617:t_109:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Bring it, $$ヴィルダーク$$! It's Emperor versus President!!」

617:t_110:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_110:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then I ask. What is justice!?」

617:t_110:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Protecting the freedom and peace of innocent people! And striking down evil like you to do it!」

617:t_110:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That straightforwardness... Is it because you're a boy?」

617:t_110:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But that resolve is a full-fledged warrior's! You're worthy of being my opponent!」

617:t_110:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do it, $$鉄人$$! We'll beat the Emperor here, and then we'll take down the $$新地球皇国$$!!」

617:t_111:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_111:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「To use the power entrusted to me for what's right!」

617:t_111:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ヴィルダーク$$! If you're a $$次元将$$ just like $$ガイオウ$$, that power should have been for fighting the $$サイデリアル$$!」

617:t_111:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You would condemn me, who became their ruler...」

617:t_111:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「For that reckless courage, I'll teach you. That doing what's right takes power.」

617:t_111:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「And that I have that power now!」

617:t_111:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then I'll surpass it! Beating you is what I should do with the power entrusted to me!!」

617:t_112:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_112:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Obviously! For this planet's freedom, peace, and future!」

617:t_112:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's what I'd like to say, but in my heart, fighting guys like you weighs just as much.」

617:t_112:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You... closely resemble $$ヴァイシュラバ$$.」

617:t_112:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I'm not out to deny it, but let me say this.」

617:t_112:5.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're covering it up with a title like Emperor, but I'd say you're the same kind as me and him.」

617:t_112:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「With this power, I will strike down men like you! And climb to even greater heights!」

617:t_112:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're the one who'll be the stepping stone, $$ヴィルダーク$$! Let's settle this!!」

617:t_113:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_113:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「For the peace and love of the universe!」

617:t_113:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「As expected of the one who defeated Emperor $$ズール$$. I sense no hesitation, no cloud.」

617:t_113:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Only by shattering that strong will can I climb to even greater heights!」

617:t_113:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The universe demands it!」

617:t_113:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「Wrong! What the universe... what people want is a peaceful world overflowing with love!!」

617:t_114:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_114:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「Obviously! To blast through anyone who takes away my freedom... everyone's freedom!」

617:t_114:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「This man... climbs all the way up to the apex of the heavens like that...」

617:t_114:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But the destination of the wind ends here. By my hand!」

617:t_114:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「My life has been a string of fights against guys like that! The $$獣人$$s... $$ロージェノム$$... the $$アンチスパイラル$$!」

617:t_114:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「But I never stopped! Believing in my power, the power I believe in!!」

617:t_114:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Come, Spiral Man! Don't think I'm the same as the $$アンチスパイラル$$!!」

617:t_115:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_115:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「For the happiness and future of everyone!」

617:t_115:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's why $$ガンバスター$$ was built, and I ride it and fight!」

617:t_115:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You, whose fate was twisted because you carry the factor of the civilization of fire... And you still keep on fighting...」

617:t_115:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I don't know what you're trying to say...! But I won't stop!」

617:t_115:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「As long as the flame burns in this heart, $$ガンバスター$$ and I will fight anyone who blocks the future!」

617:t_115:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Warrior who crossed the 12,000-year cycle! I will repay that by answering with all I have now!」

617:t_115:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Taste for yourself the power that transcends the laws of the universe!!」

617:t_116:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_116:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Sorry, but I've got no intention of chatting with you!」

617:t_116:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're the enemy of Earth and of me! I'm going to pound you flat, right now!!」

617:t_116:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I'll follow your way as well and answer with everything I have!!」

617:t_117:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_117:2.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Hard work and guts!」

617:t_117:3.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Hard work and guts!」

617:t_117:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...That's not an answer.」

617:t_117:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You wouldn't understand! How wrong it is to take away the freedom and happiness of people living hard with hard work and guts!」

617:t_117:6.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「You wouldn't understand! How wrong it is to take away the freedom and happiness of people living hard with hard work and guts!」

617:t_117:7.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「You wouldn't understand! How wrong it is to take away the freedom and happiness of people living hard with hard work and guts!」

617:t_117:8.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ will fight you! Because...!」

uncertain: 617:t_114:2: 天元まで昇る = 'climbs all the way up to the apex of the heavens' (Tengen left as a descriptive phrase; no glossary token).
617:t_115:6: １万２０００年の環 = '12,000-year cycle' (環 is literally ring/loop).
617:t_115:3: 火の文明の因子 = 'factor of the civilization of fire' (settled refrain), Noriko addressed as 'you'.
617:t_114:5: 俺の信じる俺の力を信じて = 'Believing in my power, the power I believe in'.
617:t_111:3: その統治者 read as 'their ruler' (the Sidereal's) from Kouji's line before it.
617:t_117:1-3,5-7: Nono, Buster Machine No. 7 and Diebuster speak the same line; identical English used, Nono's です tic not rendered.
Recurring 'お前に問う…お前の戦いは何のためだ？' rendered 'I ask you... What are you fighting for?' in all 10 instances; other 2088 slices may phrase it differently.
